patch_description: Replaces the topology-dependent cube entangler with a fully permutation-equivariant, trainable all-to-all phase interaction. Paired CRZ gates in both directions produce a symmetric collective ZZ-like twist, while one shared parameter keeps each block compact at five parameters. Round-robin edge scheduling exposes parallel matchings, and collective input/output rotations align the circuit symmetry with the mean-Z readout. The resulting 32-parameter model adds controlled expressivity without returning to the over-parameterized independent-wire ansätze.
